description:
Minimalist daily notes and quick capture app for Windows.

SimplNote is a minimalist Windows app for daily notes and quick capture. It supports date-based stickers, quick entry with smart dates, search across saved notes, configurable reminders about unfinished tasks, quick navigation to days that still have unfinished entries, a bilingual in-app guide, backup, import and export, and fully local storage without requiring an account.
Smart dates in Quick Capture, a redesigned reminder popup with configurable intervals, a summary of unfinished tasks after Windows starts, a new Open button for moving through days with unfinished entries, an auto-growing Quick Capture window, a bilingual in-app guide, and improved Windows autostart registration.
